newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Placer Pacific qtr net profit A$9.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Placer Pacific qtr net profit A$9.1 mln.

text.p: Placer Pacific Ltd posted its last quarterly report as a listed company on Wednesday, announcing a net profit of A$9.1 million for the three months to March 31, down from A$11.9 million a year earlier.
Sales eased to A$133.8 million from 139.1 million.
Total gold production for the March 1997 quarter was 454,970 ounces compared with 406,430 a year earlier.

Placer Pacific's parent, Placer Dome Inc, announced earlier this month its intention to move to compulsory acquisition of all the remaining Placer Pacific shares following its successful takeover bid.
Placer Dome said it now held 97.7 percent of its Australian offshoot.

The Australian Stock Exchange said on Wednesday that Placer Pacific's shares would be suspended from quotation at the close of trading on May 7 and the company would be removed from the official trading list on May 12.
